The free download link is located at the end of this article.

Play the video below to hear the included sound effects.

📝 Quick Summary

  • You will get 90 free sci-fi sound effects in 24-bit WAV format;
  • The pack contains sci-fi weapon sounds, transitions, impacts, ambiance, and more;
  • The sounds were designed by Rescopic Sound;
  • All included sounds are 100% royalty-free;
  • The free download link is at the bottom of the page.

FREE Sci-Fi Sounds

Sci-Fi Sound Effects contains 90 royalty-free sci-fi sounds for film, video production, game development, music production, and sound design.

The included sounds cover a range of typical cinematic sound effects heard in modern sci-fi productions.

It contains various sci-fi weapon sounds like blasts, refills, recoil, shots, and more. You will also find other cinematic sci-fi sounds like whooshes, impacts, particle movements, flybys, glitches, pings, and ambiances.

All sounds are meticulously crafted and edited with detailed metadata. The content is 100% royalty-free and suitable for use in your commercial projects.

The sounds are provided in 24-bit 96 kHz stereo WAV format.

How to use these Sci-Fi Sound Effects in your projects

So, who is the Sci-Fi Sound Effects library for, and who can benefit from these free sound effects?

Sci-fi sound libraries like this are a treasure trove for creative professionals across various industries, including film, video games, and music.

In film production and video editing, cinematic sci-fi sounds can completely transform a scene, adding depth and immersion to futuristic or extraterrestrial settings. The sounds included here are perfect for sci-fi films and trailers.

Game developers can use these free sci-fi SFX to improve the game’s ambiance and storytelling. The library includes various background atmosphere sounds, as well as sci-fi weapon noises that can be used for first-person style shooters and similar combat games.

For video production, especially for YouTube creators and podcasts, these free sci-fi sounds can enhance content, from sci-fi-themed vlogs to short YouTube films, adding a layer of professional sound design.

Music producers can also utilize these sound effects to incorporate unique sci-fi elements into their tracks. Mixing designed cinematic SFX with musical elements is a great technique for achieving a unique signature sound in electronic music production.

Whether for a gripping sci-fi movie, an avant-garde video game, a cutting-edge YouTube video, or an experimental music track, the sci-fi sound effects included in this free collection offer endless possibilities for creative exploration and innovation.

The sounds are provided in WAV format and fully compatible with video and audio production software like Final Cut Pro, Vegas Pro, Adobe Premiere, Ableton Live, Cubase, Pro Tools, etc.

To load the files in your software, download the free Sci-Fi Sound Effects library, extract the downloaded ZIP archive, and import the WAV files into your project.

About the artist – Rescopic Sound

Rescopic Sound is a sound design label providing quality sound effects libraries that are UCS-compatible and fully tagged with metadata.

They currently offer four sound packs: Sci-Fi Energy Weapons ($69), Parallax ($59), Distinct Whooshes ($49), and User Interaction ($69). The first two are featured in the free Sci-Fi Sound Effects collection on 99Sounds.

Rescopic Sound handpicked 90 sounds from the Sci-Fi Energy Weapons and Parallax libraries and shared them for free with the 99Sounds community.

If you like Rescopic Sound’s sound design work and appreciate these free sounds, you can show support by visiting their website and purchasing one of their commercial libraries.

Details

Sci-Fi Sound Effects contains 90 audio recordings in 24-bit WAV format (96 kHz, stereo).

The download size is 414 MB (450 MB size when extracted). Detailed metadata is also included.

The library includes the following sound categories:

  • Ambiances
  • Blasts
  • Hits
  • Movements
  • Particles
  • Pings
  • Whooshes
  • Weapons
  • Textures
  • Zaps
  • Flybys

  • 🤗 VISIT RESCOPIC SOUND
  • 🔥 MORE SOUND EFFECTS
